trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Not missable — the checklist unlocks after the story and everything in it stays available in free-roam.
trophies.guide: The longest trophy in the game and the real platinum gate. After the story, the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; anything you did during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx stresses the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it still demands every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of the game's 80 challenges. The partial targets are 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and 50 of 66 weapons. Budget about 100 hours for this step alone.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion
Clear every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest
Reach 70 of 80 challenges
Top up vehicles (200/277), animals (100/255) and weapons (50/66)
